subject.title: fix(subagent): recover terminal transcript before lost context

question: Should this PR's current-run private transcript `stop`/`end_turn` predicate become the accepted recovery boundary for the linked lost-context/output mismatch?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but it intentionally changes whether a stale child run is reported as failed or successful, so maintainer ownership of the lifecycle semantics is required before merge.

options.title: Accept Private Transcript Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head validation because the predicate is narrower than display-output recovery and follows the prior maintainer direction.

options.title: Require Live Gateway Race Proof
options.body: Ask for a real Agent Teams or Gateway run that loses context mid-run before accepting the lifecycle behavior change.

options.title: Pause Until Rebased
options.body: Keep the draft paused until the branch is refreshed against current main and the merge result is reviewed.

recommendation.title: Accept Private Transcript Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head validation because the predicate is narrower than display-output recovery and follows the prior maintainer direction.
